# Paxolab

> Professional packaging, box, and label design studio. Design engine: FORMA (vector dieline + artwork — not an image-generation model).

Marketing site (this app) informs; real design work happens in the studio.

## Product facts
- Brand: Paxolab
- Engine: FORMA — chat/brief → dieline + vector artwork
- Not Midjourney-style image gen; final print surface is vector-first
- Studio local default: http://localhost:5173 (NEXT_PUBLIC_STUDIO_URL)
- Contact: merhaba@paxolab.com
